register.labelZh: CHIP 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: chip away at 可以描述逐小塊鑿走石頭或冰,也可以描述恐懼、希望或信任隨時間逐步減弱。；chip in 可以表示某人加入對話,補充評論、問題或建議。；chip in 可以表示幾個人各自出一部分錢,分擔禮物、聚餐、旅程或其他共同費用。；chip off 和 chip something off 可以描述油漆、冰、石頭、木材等物料的小塊脫落或被除去。
register.summaryEn: Chip away at can describe removing tiny pieces from stone or ice, and it can also describe a fear, hope or trust becoming weaker over time. Chip in is a useful way to show that someone joins a conversation with a comment, question or suggestion. Chip in can show that several people each give part of the money needed for a gift, meal, trip or other shared cost. Chip off and chip something off help you describe paint, ice, stone, wood and other materials losing or having small pieces removed.
